top news.title: Robinhood launches a feature to let users link AI agents, such as Claude or Cursor, to separate, dedicated investment accounts for trading stocks autonomously

tweets.author: @robinhoodapp
tweets.text: Your strategy shouldn't sleep just because you do.  Connect your AI agent to a Robinhood Agentic Account to explore trade ideas, build and rebalance portfolios, program custom tools, and place trades as your strategy evolves.  Rolling out now.

tweets.author: @mikeisaac
tweets.text: first instinct was to be like “wha-whaaaaa?!?” but am failing to see how this is not just algorithmic trading with a different wrapper

top news.title: Meta rolls out Plus plans for Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp globally, will test $7.99/mo. and $19.99/mo. Meta AI plans, a $49.99/mo. creator plan, and more

tweets.author: @financejack44
tweets.text: Something else that's interesting about the new $META subscriptions is they AREN'T ad free.  So $META is not sacrificing any advertising revenue with the rollout of these paid experiences.  If they can create a decent value proposition for the subscriptions without removing ads that's a HUGE monetization lever.

tweets.author: @rihardjarc
tweets.text: Did people really expect $META wouldn't charge a subscription for AI products and use their +3B distribution network?  $SNAP makes $5B in ad revenue and $1B in direct subs revenue (growing 87% YoY).  $META can add a few $10B to its bottom line just by providing solid-value subscriptions.  Distribution is the ultimate AI bottleneck and moat, as we have AI models and services available in every app and platform.

tweets.author: @supbagholder
tweets.text: @RihardJarc I already pay for Instagram Plus. It's great to track who views my stories/what performs. Lots of value to unlock with subscriptions imo.

top news.title: Valve raises Steam Deck OLED prices due to “rising memory and storage costs”; the 512GB model is now $789, up from $549, and the 1TB model is $949, up from $649

tweets.author: @genepark
tweets.text: the steam deck is a top 3 gaming device or console i've ever owned. it's also now no longer worth buying. i wanted to get another spare one but so much for that. unbelievably, the xbox rog ally x is now vastly better priced atm at $1,000, more powerful than steam deck.

tweets.author: @carygolomb
tweets.text: It is such a crazy time that I'm actually saying out loud, actually don't even bother getting a Steam Deck OLED, just get the Xbox ALLY X

tweets.author: @jezcorden
tweets.text: I expect PlayStation and Xbox to increase prices again before this is all over. CHINESE MEMORY PLS SAVE US.
